userRoles.name: Board of Directors / Principal
userRoles.description: Full governance, academic curriculum approval, staff assignments, and database administration.

userRoles.name: Academic Coordinator / Administrator
userRoles.description: Day-to-day academic scheduling, Cambridge stage moderation, student directory, and announcements.

userRoles.name: Cambridge Lead Educator
userRoles.description: Evaluate Cambridge subject progress, mentor student portfolios, and access teacher resources.

userRoles.name: Learning Facilitator & Mentor
userRoles.description: Support practical projects, allotment & outdoor discovery activities, and attendance.

userRoles.name: Admissions & Student Registrar
userRoles.description: Register enrolled students (ages 2–18), maintain parent contact details, and manage visit bookings.

userRoles.name: Parent / Auditor Portal Viewer
userRoles.description: Read-only access to student evaluation reports, Cambridge progress charts, and school calendar.
